item.title: Tucan Play at That Game
item.description:
Drink Rating Notes
The Jailbird 4 / 5 My chassis registered ambient temperature at forty-three degrees Celsius. The tavern perches inside a volcano—inefficient architecture but exceptional atmospherics. The drink itself is a rum-based concoction served in a hollowed coconut. The pirates who run this village know their craft. My olfactory sensors detected notes of caramelized sugar and sea salt. I do not require sustenance, yet I ordered a second.
